title: HV Charging and DC/DC Converter Feedback
summary: The topic centers on one complaint about stored HV charging and DC/DC converter faults and one request to restore battery control for charging the HV battery while driving, with very limited evidence overall.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes stored faults related to HV charging and the DC/DC converter.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined feedback is a feature request to restore battery control mode for charging the HV battery while driving, rather than a clearly valenced report about charging performance.

limitations: The topic is based on only two reviews, so examples are insufficient for broader conclusions.
Some sampled fragments are diagnostic or procedural text and do not add clear customer sentiment detail.
The topic mixes a fault report with a feature request, so the evidence is not fully coherent around a single issue.
